── 2026-10-19 (ADR-1759, LIVE-933). Owner reopened the program ("Begin the editor program"). check:email-blocks (EDITOR-GATES §5, E1 to E9) is in package.json and the ci.yml guards array, green on the tree it protects; its own row is LIVE-933. Gate state for this row: check:node-document-safety (LIVE-871) and check:email-blocks landed; check:blocks, check:surface-binding and check:loom-integrity wait on E1's registry root (defineBlock), since each hard-fails on an absent root. Next on the critical path: task 10 (per-type limits replace the six dedupe sets; stored bench).

── 2026-10-19 (ADR-1830, LIVE-960). Task 10 landed: the six dedupe sets (rows-ops normalize; layout parseRows, sanitizeRows, sanitizeEntityLayout, mergeEntityLayout, resolveRows) are deleted and lib/entity-blocks/block-limits.ts holds the one per-type policy (data once, design thrice, content unlimited), so two Text blocks coexist and a second Offerings is refused at every site; entity-grid keys blocks by position. Still type-keyed until task 11: content/style bags and hidden. Next on the critical path: task 11 (rows-ops to node ops, bags fold into the node, per-node sanitize).

── 2026-10-19 (ADR-1831, LIVE-1000). Task 11 landed as pure modules: lib/entity-blocks/node-ops.ts holds the node mutations (by nid, bags travel with the node, stored bench), sanitizeNodeLayout (per-node field sanitizers, unknown types preserved, rows folded to the kind maximum) and resolveNodeRows. No writer, renderer or editor switched; LIVE-875/877/887 stand. Next on the critical path: task 12 (renderNode, the 13 renderer and editor files, selectedNid), then 14 behind render_path, then 15.

── 2026-10-19 (ADR-1832, LIVE-1001). Task 12, read half, landed: EntityGrid is generic over its cell item, node-ops gains resolveNodeRowsFor, and the member and Space profile renderers render nodes on their grid paths (node.content / node.style per placement), proven byte-identical to the type-keyed render by goldens frozen before the switch (member-profile-modules.golden.json, space-profile-modules.golden.json). Still type-keyed until 12b (LIVE-1002): the store (selectedId), live-profile-grid, profile-page-builder, the Space canvas editor, the email studio editor, the owner previews, house-home. Next on the critical path: 12b, then 13 (email, goldens first) and 14.

── 2026-10-19 (ADR-1833, LIVE-1002). Task 2 landed, pulled ahead of 12b and 14: five render_path_* flags seeded false (migration 20270346011400), lib/render-path.ts reads fail-closed, switch on /admin/page-layout. The first branch point is the task 14 writer switch. Next: 12b and 14 together behind these flags.

── 2026-10-19 (ADR-1834, LIVE-1003). Task 14, Space slice: saveSpaceProfileLayout is the first real render_path branch point. With render_path_space_profile on it stores a sanitized node document; publish and discard work over stored nodes; everything else keeps the LIVE-887 refusal. Nothing sends nodes yet. Next: the store (selectedNid) and the Space canvas editor sending nodes behind the flag.

── 2026-10-19 (ADR-1835, LIVE-1004). Task 12b, store slice: components/entity-blocks/node-layout-store.tsx, a node-keyed twin of the live store (selectedNid, edit over the freshest layout, coalesced undo, debounced serialized node save). Separate on purpose; nothing imports it yet. Next: the Space canvas, live grid and page builder onto it behind render_path_space_profile, then the email studio editor.

── 2026-10-19 (ADR-1836, LIVE-1005). Task 12b, mount slice: EntityLayoutMount wraps its children in NodeLayoutProvider at the same position; the store imports types only and resets in place on a subject change. Inert until seeded. Production build check required (shell weight). Next: the on-page node grid, the builder and the Space canvas read the store behind render_path_space_profile.

── 2026-10-19 (ADR-1837, LIVE-1006). Task 12b, binding slice: useEditorBinding gives SpaceCanvasBlock and SpacePublishFab one slice of whichever store is in charge (node store once seeded, live store otherwise); the canvas block selects by nid. Inert. 12b re-estimated: still to come are the on-page node grid, the page builder and block-edit-panel, the owner preview choosing the node grid, then email studio and the member side. render_path_space_profile stays off until the Space set is complete.

── 2026-10-19 (ADR-1838, LIVE-1007). Task 12b, grid slice: LiveNodeGrid renders and edits a Space node document from the node store (rows from resolveNodeRows, edits by nid, Map for refs). Dormant. Next: the page builder and block-edit-panel, then the owner preview choosing the node grid behind render_path_space_profile.
